title: The Last Supper
description: Jesus prepares and celebrates the Passover meal with his disciples, washes their feet, institutes communion with the bread and wine as his body and blood, and predicts that one of them will betray him.

versions.title: The Last Supper
versions.description: Jesus prepares and celebrates the Passover meal with his disciples, washes their feet, institutes communion with the bread and wine as his body and blood, and predicts that one of them will betray him.
versions.reason: [minor] references: John 13:1–30 overlaps with the existing story 'Jesus washes the disciples' feet' (John 13:1–17). The existing story focuses on the foot washing, while this one covers the entire last meal, including the institution of the Lord's Supper and the prediction of betrayal. It is natural that the foot washing is part of the last meal, but since it already exists as a separate account, the John reference could be limited to 13:18–30 (the prediction of betrayal) to avoid overlap. Still, it is also legitimate to keep the entire scene as one narrative unit.
